note: the eye the film draws for the Sun, frames 0 to 269, at the middle of the shutter (time = (frame + shutterFraction / 2) / fps). stage: position in stage units and camera quaternion (x, y, z, w; the camera looks down its own -z, y up) in the frame of the close view (src/stops/sun/stage.ts: the ball has radius stage.radius about stage.centre). body: the same eye in radii of the ball from its centre, in the body axes of place.json (body = toBody * (stage - centre) / radius), with the globe carried as at that frame. height: the eye above the ball in radii. From frame 180 on the film draws the globe side (view orbit) and this is that eye taken back into the stage.
